label: spring_r2_test__whistle_bn_bd_a100
decoding: greedy (argmax), language tag bn forced, control pieces banned, length cap 12 tokens/s + 8, no external LM
harness: bn-whistle src/gpu_bench.py (the benchmark's asr_core.py audio path and PCM16 staging), imported by scripts/bench_add_whistle.py (rows matched to the benchmark's, piece counts and forced cuts checked)
runtime: JAX 0.12.0 (jaxlib 0.12.0, CUDA 12 PJRT plugin), needle's Whistle model (cactus-needle 3.2.1), XLA-compiled
numerics: deployed W4/A8: CQ 4-bit weights (cq_ste_params), 8-bit activations and KV (configure_deploy act_bits=8 kv_bits=8), bfloat16 compute
optimisations: all shape buckets compiled before timing; encoder input padded to the next 2 s bucket (length-masked) and its output to the 30 s frame count; greedy loop on device (lax.while_loop per 64-token decoder bucket, one host sync per bucket); decoder recomputes the prefix each step (no KV-cache path in needle's Whistle)
speed_note: per-clip wall time from asr_core.load_audio through chunking, PCM16 staging, encode and greedy decode of every piece to the joined text; the device is synchronised when the tokens are read back; one warm-up clip discarded, compile time excluded
